address: 30 Charlotte Street, Fitzrovia, London, W1T 2NG, United Kingdom
bio: A potent taste of Portugal is the order of the day at this pulsating restaurant on Fitzrovia’s restaurant-dense Charlotte Street. Come on a busy evening and soak up the atmosphere emanating from both your fellow diners and the open kitchen in full flight. The menu lists the likes of Ibérico suckling pig and the signature ‘amêijoas à bulhão pato’ clams, while for dessert don’t overlook the intriguingly named ‘toucinho do céu’ (‘bacon from heaven’), which is in fact a terrific almond tart. If you’re feeling indecisive, bring some friends and order the chef’s selection menu.
